# CINEK — artist universe
A public index for the Cinek artist universe project.

- Home: /
- Artist overview: /#artist
- Music catalogue: /#music
- Social directory: /#links
- Creative archive/wiki: /wiki/
- JSON index: /api/index.json
- Songs: /api/songs.json
- Social links: /api/socials.json
- MCP endpoint: /mcp

Important: this is an independent project scaffold. The official Linktree currently serves as the verified social/streaming directory:
https://linktr.ee/noahcinek

Direct social/profile URLs, individual track URLs, video URLs, artist canon, media assets and commercial permissions must be verified before being represented as official.
